name: lcd2004
title: 2004 character LCD
description: A 20x4 character LCD with no backpack: 16 contacts in a row, wired by RS, E and D4 to D7 with RW to ground
notes: C2004A on the back. U1 to U3 are blobs, so which HD44780 or clone is under them is not seen.
R8 and R9, marked 680, stand beside the backlight pads A and K at the left edge; their path is not traced.
do: VO to the wiper of a potentiometer between VDD and VSS: it sets the contrast

front.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened

back.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened

contacts.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13: 16 contacts at the top left of the front, only 1 and 16 printed; the names between are the order of the usual 2004, which the 2004 with a backpack of the same photos prints as GND VDD VO RS RW E D0-D7 BLA BLK

controller.source: the controller is under a blob; every 2004 of this kind takes the commands of the HD44780. Not tried.

levels.source: The usual 2004 takes 5 V. The HD44780 pulls RS and D0 to D7 up to VDD by its datasheet, so its lines are of VDD. Not measured.
